scope: Full Wan unscrew and rinse regeneration with smooth pose-capsule support
summary: Smooth pose-capsule support eliminated the prior black mask artifacts, but both full candidates regenerated large pink human-hand/skin residuals in the interaction region. They are rejected and not packaged.
evidence: The immutable runs full-v3/unscrew-bottle-cap/20260811T111600Z-3a6539f7 and full-v3/rinse-bottle/20260811T111600Z-473a864e both succeeded at 880x512, 240 frames, and 24 FPS.
Their hybrid union-mask means are 0.5712 and 0.5514, with smooth camera-frame support and no high-frequency black islands.
Every-fourth-frame sheets and full-resolution key frames show persistent pink hand-shaped generated regions around both grippers; the zero-human-residual hard gate fails.
lessons: Correct mask topology can remove conditioning artifacts without preventing the model's human-hand prior from returning on an unseen manipulation.
Do not repair generated skin by restoring source pixels or blurring; route to a clean robot-native candidate instead.
limitations: This attempt isolates a visual prior failure but does not identify a specific internal attention layer.
Neither Wan candidate is used in the final comparison.
next_actions: Use clean H3 robot-only frames through task completion and hold the accepted terminal state without interpolation.
